apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-ingress
  namespace: k8s-networkpolicy
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: frontend-to-api
  namespace: k8s-networkpolicy
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels: {app: api}
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels: {role: frontend}
      ports:
        - port: 80
# Three workloads in one namespace. Only frontend may call api.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: k8s-networkpolicy
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: api}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: api, tier: backend}
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 1
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: busybox:1.37.0
          command: ["sh", "-c", "mkdir -p /www && echo api > /www/index.html && exec httpd -f -p 8080 -h /www"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: k8s-networkpolicy
spec:
  selector: {app: api}
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frontend
  namespace: k8s-networkpolicy
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: frontend}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: frontend, tier: web}
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 1
      containers:
        - name: frontend
          image: busybox:1.37.0
          command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: batch
  namespace: k8s-networkpolicy
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: batch}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: batch, tier: backend}
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 1
      containers:
        - name: batch
          image: busybox:1.37.0
          command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
apps.yaml

content.text:
I fixed `frontend-to-api` in `netpol.yaml`. After applying it to the live cluster, `frontend` gets `api` back from `http://api/` and `batch` times out. I haven't run the verifier's delete-and-reapply test.

There were two bugs in the policy:
- **Selector:** it matched pods labelled `role: frontend`, but the frontend pods carry `app: frontend`. I changed it to `app: frontend`.
- **Port:** the rule allowed port 80, which is the Service port. NetworkPolicy matches the pod's container port, which is 8080, so I changed it to 8080.

I left the default-deny ingress policy and `apps.yaml` unchanged.
